description: Prediction responses as the client's bindings (sdm_api.generated.tfm_api's PredictionResponse.from_dict) read them, which sdm-wire's reader reads alike (tests/response_vectors.rs): each body read, or refused naming the field the reader refuses first.

vectors.name: members the bindings do not read
predictions as an object with members
an answer that is not an object

boundaries_description: T1.28b's boundary-vector matrix: each a whole answer (status and body text) to the call base.regression's request makes on the reference, and the reference's public outcome of SDMClient.predict given it (the result, or the refusal: class, code, HTTP status, the endpoint's own message and details). A vector naming a divergence may end otherwise on the core only once that register entry is approved.
